newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Ten die in boat accident off Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Ten die in boat accident off Vietnam.

text.p: Ten people died off the southern coast of Vietnam last week when a boat heading for the island of Phu Quy was engulfed by a wave and sank, a local official in the province of Binh Thuan said on Wednesday.
Twenty-seven of the 37 people on board the boat, which was transporting goods and firewood as well as passengers, were rescued.
The bodies of a woman and a child were recovered, but the bodies of the eight others were not likely to be found soon because of stormy weather conditions, the official said.
